guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：光學薄膜干涉鍍膜
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Optical interference coatings
guides.concept: 從單層膜的 Fresnel 振幅相加出發，用特徵矩陣與導納轉換推導四分之一波堆的反射率與阻帶寬度，再討論氧化物與氟化物材料、蒸鍍與濺鍍的微結構差異、石英晶體與光學監控、分光光度驗證與逆向工程、入射角與環境造成的光譜位移，直到均勻性夾具、環境測試與驗收交接。
guides.conceptEn: Beginning with Fresnel amplitudes adding in a single film, derive quarter-wave-stack reflectance and stop-band width with the characteristic matrix and admittance transformation, then cover oxide and fluoride materials, the microstructural difference between evaporated and sputtered films, quartz-crystal and optical monitoring, spectrophotometric verification and reverse engineering, spectral shifts with incidence angle and environment, and finally uniformity fixtures, environmental testing and acceptance handoff.
procedure: 一層厚度 d、折射率 n₁ 的透明薄膜有兩個界面，各自依 Fresnel 公式反射一部分振幅；兩束反射光的相位差由光程 2n₁d·cosθ 決定，彼此可以相消或相加。當光學厚度 n₁d 等於四分之一波長時，兩個界面的反射相位相反，若 n₁ 介於入射介質與基板之間反射率下降，若 n₁ 高於基板反射率反而上升；光學厚度為半波時薄膜「隱形」，反射率回到裸基板值。這個單層結果是所有干涉鍍膜的基本單元，也說明為何同一層膜在不同波長下行為完全不同。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「單層膜的兩個界面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

多層膜用每層的 2×2 特徵矩陣連乘來計算，矩陣元素只含該層的折射率與相位厚度，整個膜系在入射側呈現一個等效導納 Y，反射率就是 [(n₀ − Y)/(n₀ + Y)]²。四分之一波層的矩陣特別簡單：它把後方的導納 Y 轉成 n²/Y，所以高低折射率交替的 (HL)ᴺ 堆每加一對就把導納乘上 (n_H/n_L)²，反射率隨對數迅速逼近 1。阻帶寬度只由折射率比決定，與層數無關；層數只決定阻帶內的反射率深度與帶邊陡度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四分之一波堆與導納」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

可見與近紅外鍍膜以氧化物為主：SiO₂（1.46）作低折射率層，Al₂O₃（1.63）、HfO₂（1.95）、Ta₂O₅（2.10）、Nb₂O₅（2.30）與 TiO₂（2.35）作高折射率層；紫外區要避開 TiO₂ 與 Ta₂O₅ 的吸收邊，改用 HfO₂ 或氟化物如 MgF₂（1.38）與 LaF₃；紅外區則用 ZnS、Ge、YbF₃。材料選擇同時受吸收係數、應力、硬度與與基板的附著力限制。蒸鍍膜常呈柱狀多孔結構，堆積密度 0.8 到 0.9，孔隙吸水後折射率上升、光譜紅移；離子輔助或濺鍍能把密度推近 1，光譜才能穩定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氧化物與氟化物膜材」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

電子束蒸鍍的原子到達能量只有約 0.1 eV，形成柱狀多孔膜，加上離子輔助（IAD）能把密度提高；磁控濺鍍與離子束濺鍍（IBS）的到達能量為數 eV 到數十 eV，膜層緻密、非晶且損耗最低，但 IBS 速率僅約 0.1 nm/s；原子層沉積以自限反應逐層生長，共形性最好但更慢。厚度監控有兩類：石英晶體微天平依 Sauerbrey 關係把質量變化轉成頻率變化，需要校正「工具因子」把晶體位置換算到基板位置；光學監控直接看監控片在控制波長的穿透或反射率，在四分之一波轉折點停止，具有自我補償誤差的特性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「蒸鍍與濺鍍源、石英晶體監控」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鍍膜完成後用分光光度計量穿透率與反射率光譜，絕對精度約 0.1% 到 0.3%，再與設計曲線比對；差異可用逆向工程把各層厚度與折射率當成未知數擬合，找出是哪一層、哪一種誤差造成偏移。損耗以 1 − R − T 分解成吸收與散射，吸收由光熱或光腔衰盪法量到 ppm 等級，散射由總積分散射儀取得。對窄帶濾光片，中心波長對光學厚度極度敏感，所以驗證必須同時說明量測的波長準確度與光束發散角。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「分光光度計與逆向工程」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

薄膜的相位厚度含 cosθ 因子，入射角增加時每層的有效光學厚度變小，整個光譜向短波移動；位移量由一個等效折射率決定，高折射率膜系位移較小。斜入射時 s 與 p 偏振的 Fresnel 係數不同，阻帶寬度與帶邊位置分裂，45° 的分光鏡必須分別對兩個偏振設計。公差預算把厚度、折射率、均勻性與入射角誤差各自換算成波長位移，以均方根相加，再與規格的帶邊容差比較，決定哪一項必須被製程或量測收緊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「入射角與偏振造成的光譜位移」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鍍膜腔內的沉積速率隨位置變化：點狀蒸發源向上方平面沉積的厚度隨離軸距離下降，因此基板放在旋轉的行星轉架上並加上修正遮罩，把全批的厚度差壓到 0.5% 以內；濺鍍系統則靠靶材與基板幾何及公轉達到相同目的。每一批放入與產品同材料的見證片，用於光譜、附著與環境測試。環境耐久依 ISO 9211 或軍規序列進行：濕熱、鹽霧、溫度循環、膠帶附著與橡皮擦磨耗，確認膜層不會起泡、龜裂或脫落。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「行星轉架、均勻性遮罩與環境測試」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鍍膜規格必須同時指定波段、入射角範圍、偏振、基板材料、穿透或反射的平均值與極值，以及環境等級與（若適用）雷射損傷門檻；缺少任一項，驗收就沒有依據。因為量測有不確定度，驗收必須設保護帶：量測值必須比規格好於量測不確定度的範圍才能判定合格。交接資料包含設計層結構摘要（不含製程配方）、見證片光譜、逆向工程結果、均勻性分佈、環境測試報告與批次編號，讓系統整合端能追溯每片元件的鍍膜狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鍍膜規格表與批次追溯紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A transparent film of thickness d and index n₁ has two interfaces, each reflecting part of the amplitude according to the Fresnel equations; the phase difference between the two reflected waves is set by the path 2n₁d·cosθ, so they can cancel or reinforce. When the optical thickness n₁d equals a quarter wavelength the two reflections are in antiphase: reflectance drops if n₁ lies between the incident medium and substrate, but rises if n₁ exceeds the substrate index; at half-wave thickness the film is absentee and reflectance returns to the bare-substrate value. This single-layer result is the basic unit of every interference coating and shows why one film behaves completely differently at different wavelengths. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “The two interfaces of a single film”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A multilayer is computed by multiplying the 2×2 characteristic matrix of each layer, whose elements contain only that layer's index and phase thickness; the whole stack presents an equivalent admittance Y on the incident side, and reflectance is [(n₀ − Y)/(n₀ + Y)]². A quarter-wave layer has an especially simple matrix: it transforms the admittance behind it, Y, into n²/Y, so each added pair of an alternating (HL)ᴺ stack multiplies the admittance by (n_H/n_L)² and reflectance approaches 1 rapidly with pair count. The stop-band width depends only on the index ratio, not on the layer count; the count sets only the reflectance depth inside the band and the edge steepness. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Quarter-wave stack and admittance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Visible and near-infrared coatings rely mainly on oxides: SiO₂ (1.46) as the low-index layer and Al₂O₃ (1.63), HfO₂ (1.95), Ta₂O₅ (2.10), Nb₂O₅ (2.30) or TiO₂ (2.35) as high-index layers; in the ultraviolet the absorption edges of TiO₂ and Ta₂O₅ must be avoided in favour of HfO₂ or fluorides such as MgF₂ (1.38) and LaF₃, while the infrared uses ZnS, Ge and YbF₃. The choice is also bounded by absorption coefficient, stress, hardness and adhesion to the substrate. Evaporated films are often columnar and porous with packing density 0.8 to 0.9; water filling the pores raises the index and red-shifts the spectrum, and only ion assistance or sputtering pushes density toward 1 so the spectrum stays stable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Oxide and fluoride film materials”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Electron-beam evaporation delivers adatoms with only about 0.1 eV, producing columnar porous films, and ion-assisted deposition raises their density; magnetron and ion-beam sputtering arrive with several to tens of eV, giving dense amorphous films with the lowest loss, though IBS runs at only about 0.1 nm/s; atomic layer deposition grows self-limiting monolayers with the best conformality but is slower still. Thickness monitoring comes in two kinds: a quartz-crystal microbalance converts mass change into frequency change through the Sauerbrey relation and needs a calibrated tooling factor to map crystal position to substrate position, while optical monitoring watches the transmittance or reflectance of a witness at a control wavelength and stops at the quarter-wave turning point, which self-compensates thickness errors. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Evaporation and sputter sources, quartz-crystal monitor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

After deposition the transmittance and reflectance spectra are measured on a spectrophotometer with an absolute accuracy of about 0.1% to 0.3% and compared with the design curve; the difference is fitted by reverse engineering, treating layer thicknesses and indices as unknowns, to find which layer and which error type caused the deviation. Loss is decomposed as 1 − R − T into absorption and scatter, absorption measured to ppm by photothermal or cavity ring-down methods and scatter by total-integrated-scatter instruments. For narrowband filters the centre wavelength is extremely sensitive to optical thickness, so verification must state the wavelength accuracy and beam divergence of the measurement. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Spectrophotometer and reverse engineering”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The phase thickness of a film carries a cosθ factor, so as incidence angle grows every layer's effective optical thickness shrinks and the whole spectrum moves to shorter wavelengths; the shift is governed by an effective index, with high-index stacks shifting less. At oblique incidence the s and p Fresnel coefficients differ, so stop-band width and edge positions split, and a 45° beam splitter must be designed for each polarization separately. The tolerance budget converts thickness, index, uniformity and angle errors into wavelength shifts, adds them root-sum-square and compares the total with the specified edge tolerance to decide which term the process or metrology must tighten. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Angle- and polarization-induced spectral shift”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Deposition rate inside a chamber varies with position: a point-like evaporation source coats a plane above it with thickness falling off-axis, so substrates ride on a rotating planetary fixture with correction masks to hold the batch thickness spread within 0.5%, while sputtering systems reach the same goal through target-substrate geometry and planetary motion. Each batch carries witness samples of the same material as the product for spectral, adhesion and environmental tests. Durability follows ISO 9211 or military-specification sequences: humidity, salt fog, temperature cycling, tape adhesion and eraser abrasion, confirming that the film neither blisters, cracks nor delaminates. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Planetary fixture, uniformity mask and environmental tests”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A coating specification must state band, incidence-angle range, polarization, substrate material, average and extreme transmittance or reflectance, environmental class and, where relevant, laser-damage threshold; missing any item leaves acceptance without a basis. Because measurements carry uncertainty, acceptance needs a guard band: the measured value must beat the specification by the measurement uncertainty before a pass is declared. The handoff package holds a design summary of the layer structure (not the process recipe), witness spectra, reverse-engineering results, uniformity map, environmental test report and batch numbers so the system integrator can trace each element's coating state. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Coating specification sheet and batch-traceability record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 把高折射率單層誤當成增透膜鍍在透鏡上，反射率反而由 4% 升到 30%，整組鏡頭的穿透率與鬼影同時惡化。
用發散角 3° 的光束量窄帶濾光片，有效入射角使通帶變寬且中心藍移，合格品被誤判為不合格；或只量穿透率不量反射率，把吸收當成散射去追查粗糙度，方向完全錯誤。
pitfallsEn: Depositing a high-index single layer as if it were an antireflection film raises reflectance from 4% to 30%, degrading lens transmission and ghost images together.

Measuring a narrowband filter with a 3° divergent beam broadens the passband and blue-shifts it through the effective incidence angle, rejecting good parts; measuring transmission only and attributing the missing light to scatter sends the investigation after roughness when the real cause is absorption.

courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 增透膜設計與沉積
related.transfer: 可遷移「單層膜干涉與 Fresnel 振幅相加」與「光譜驗證、逆向工程與損耗分解」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；增透膜設計與沉積的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Single-film interference and Fresnel amplitude addition" and "Spectral verification, reverse engineering and loss decomposition" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Antireflection coating design and deposition must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以特徵矩陣與導納把多層膜設計、材料、沉積監控與光譜驗證連成可交付的鍍膜工程；增透膜設計與沉積則以用導納匹配設計單層、V 形與寬帶增透膜，並把沉積、量測與鏡頭鬼影預算串成可驗收的工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on linking multilayer design, materials, deposition monitoring and spectral verification through the characteristic matrix and admittance into deliverable coating engineering; Antireflection coating design and deposition centres on designing single-layer, V-coat and broadband antireflection films by admittance matching and tying deposition, metrology and lens ghost budgets into acceptable engineering, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 光學薄膜干涉鍍膜
history.text: 1817 年 Fraunhofer 注意到表面風化的玻璃反射較弱，1886 年 Rayleigh 以漸變折射率解釋；1935 年蔡司的 Alexander Smakula 取得真空蒸鍍增透膜專利，1946 年 Max Auwärter 在列支敦斯登創立 Balzers，把真空鍍膜變成產業。Angus Macleod 於 1969 年出版的《Thin-Film Optical Filters》確立了特徵矩陣與導納圖的設計語言；1980 年代離子輔助與離子束濺鍍把膜層密度推近塊材，1990 年代光纖通訊的密集分波多工濾光片把厚度控制推到 0.01% 等級。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1817 Fraunhofer noticed that weathered glass reflects less, and in 1886 Rayleigh explained it with a graded index; in 1935 Alexander Smakula at Zeiss patented vacuum-evaporated antireflection coatings, and in 1946 Max Auwärter founded Balzers in Liechtenstein, turning vacuum coating into an industry. Angus Macleod's Thin-Film Optical Filters of 1969 established the characteristic-matrix and admittance-diagram design language; in the 1980s ion assistance and ion-beam sputtering pushed film density toward bulk, and in the 1990s dense-wavelength-division-multiplexing filters for fibre communication drove thickness control to the 0.01% level. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「單層膜干涉與 Fresnel 振幅相加」到「規格書、保護帶與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Single-film interference and Fresnel amplitude addition" through "Specification sheet, guard band and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
